defects.title: The help text describes the fcont flag the wrong way round
defects.trigger: reading the OPTIONAL INPUTS of hit_node (varargin{11})
defects.observed: fcont documented as true if fluxes were supplied; createMetIntrcNetwork sets fcont = 1 for the default all-ones fluxes and hit_node colours by flux only for fcont = 0
defects.expected: fcont = 1 when no fluxes were supplied

notes: Callback called directly with a struct standing for the clicked text object (.String, .Parent.Parent.SelectionType); right click (model network), left click (sub-network), threshold, excluded mets, weight floor 1e-6, NaN width, scale/colour bar, 'open' click all checked; figures created with DefaultFigureVisible off (restored) and closed. Lines 163-167 dead: line 127 replaces every NaN of LWidths, so the elseif of line 154 is always true. rmnode with names absent from the graph is a no-op (probed), so no defect there.
Global CB_MAP_OUTPUT saved and restored (cleared if the test created it). Warning for 'java' checked with lastwarn (not suppressed).

defects.title: The overlay content is truncated to 'name' before it is sent
defects.trigger: any call, e.g. generateSubsytemsLayout(minerva, model, 'S1') with two subsystem reactions and minerva.map = 'ReconMap-2.01'
defects.observed: MATLAB R2025a: sprintf('name%09reactionIdentifier%09lineWidth%09color%0D%09R1%095%09#009933%0D') returns 'name' (4 chars, codes [110 97 109 101]); '%09r' is read as an incomplete format specifier, so postMINERVArequest receives content 'name' and no reaction
defects.expected: content with the header and one URL-encoded line per subsystem reaction (buildFluxDistLayout sends the encoded text without sprintf)

notes: Reproduction (MATLAB): content = strcat('name%09reactionIdentifier%09lineWidth%09color%0D', strcat('%09', 'R1', '%09', '5', '%09', '#009933', '%0D')); out = sprintf(content)  % -> 'name'. Line 54 runs for every call, so every call reaches the defect; caller generateSubsystemLayouts is reached. A full test would replace postMINERVArequest (internet) by a recording stub on a tempname path (pattern of testLp_solve). Legacy test/verifiedTests/visualization/testReconMap/testReconMap.m calls it too (internet, also buildFluxDistLayout), so it is not a single-function test of it.
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproduction: sprintf(content) treats the overlay content as a format and cuts it to 'name' on every call)

notes: Codes checked against the CSS named-colour table. The source lists 142 names (MEDIUMSLATEBLUE twice, same code) so Count is 141; the author line says 143 colours - not recorded as a defect (attribution text, no behaviour).

notes:
Severity follows the precedents 'Flux values are rounded to the default precision of num2str' and 'A numeric literal ID is not deleted' (both limitation); the lead may raise it to wrong-result (then quarantine; reproduction: map.rxnName = {'1'; '10'}; map.molAlias = {'a';'b';'c'}; map.rxnBaseReactantAlias = {{'a'};{'b'}}; map.rxnReactantAlias = {{};{}}; map.rxnBaseProductAlias = {{'b'};{'c'}}; map.rxnProductAlias = {{};{}}; map.rxnColor = {'FF000000';'FF000000'}; CSV file 'rxnID,flux
1,5
10,10
'; [m2, flux2, fluxMap] = addFluxFromFileWidthAndColor(map, csvFile)). Numeric IDs of one length are tested. Line 47 unreachable: readtable without 'TextType' gives char cells, never strings. readtable skips the header row automatically (probed).

Hand-built map with unknown species/aliases (skipped) and a species on both sides of one reaction (the product loop runs last, so +1). allowInconsistency is hard-coded 0, so the '|| allowInconsistency' operands never decide anything (no separate line).

defects.title: The check for a removed only reactant or product compares with the whole alias list
defects.trigger: a reaction with one reactant (product) species reference whose alias was removed from map.molAlias, or a one-alias map whose alias is that reference
defects.observed: strcmp(alias, map.molAlias) gives one logical per alias and 'if' needs all true: the error 'removing only substrate in reaction' / '... product ...' is never raised for maps of two or more aliases (the removed reference stays in the file) and is raised for a one-alias map where nothing was removed
defects.expected: the error only when the single reference's alias is not in map.molAlias

defects.title: Map information can be added or changed but not removed
defects.trigger: emptied molCompartAlias, specNotes or rxnNotes, or rxnReversibility 'true' for a reaction read as reversible="false"
defects.observed: written only when non-empty (or 'false'), so the xmlStruct value stays in the file

defects.title: The error for a single secondary reactant or product link with several map aliases says 'should not be cell'
defects.trigger: map with two secondary reactants (products) for a reaction whose XML has one link (struct)
defects.observed: error 'should not be cell' although the link is not a cell
defects.expected: a message naming the inconsistent aliases

defects.title: Every '~' of the file name is replaced by the home folder
defects.trigger: a file name starting with '~' that contains another '~'
defects.observed: strrep replaces each '~', not only the leading one

notes: Fixture: a small CellDesigner file written by the test into a tempname folder and read with transformXML2Map (also untested, used only as reader; round trip of the map is exact). The XML round trip differs only by the reaction celldesigner:name the function adds (asserted). Lines 212-215, 246-249 dead (after error()). '~' branch covered by climbing from the home folder into tempname (Unix only). xmlread (via transformXML2Map) makes the JVM create its attach socket .java_pid<pid> in tempdir (probed); measureCoverage reported it as leftover, so the test deletes sockets that appear during the test. The guard defect could be read as 'error' severity (spurious error on a one-alias map); classed limitation because that map is degenerate (its only alias must be both sole reactant and sole product) - lead to confirm. Legacy test/verifiedTests/visualization/testMetabolicCartography/testCD/testCD.m round-trips glycolysisAndTCA.xml through transformXML2Map and transformMap2XML (purpose: transformXML2Map), so it is not a single-function test of it.

defects.title: The optional areaWidth is not defaulted when areaHeight is given
defects.observed: MATLAB R2025a: 'Not enough input arguments.' at changeNodesArea line 42; areaWidth = 70.0 is set only inside 'if nargin < 3'
defects.expected: heights set to areaHeight and widths to the default 70

notes: Reproduction (MATLAB): map.specID = {'s1';'s2'}; map.specName = {'A';'B'}; map.molID = {'s1';'s2';'s1'}; map.molHeight = {'40';'40';'40'}; map.molWidth = {'80';'80';'80'}; changeNodesArea(map, {'A'}, 30)  % -> Not enough input arguments. (line 42). Severity per the consistency rule (documented optional argument that cannot be omitted). Confined to the three-input call form; no src/ file calls changeNodesArea. The two- and four-input forms work (would be fully coverable).
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproduction: the documented three-input call fails at line 42; consistency rule)
